onboarding.title: Welcome to Moda Interact
onboarding.heading: Recover more abandoned checkouts
onboarding.description: Moda Interact helps you reconnect with customers who leave before completing their purchase.
onboarding.planDescription: Choose the plan that works best for your store to start using Moda Interact.

onboarding.hero.title: Recover abandoned checkouts through conversations that feel natural.
onboarding.hero.description: Moda Interact automatically turns abandoned Shopify checkouts into AI-powered WhatsApp recovery conversations, helping you reconnect with shoppers in the language that suits them.
onboarding.hero.noSeparateBilling: messaging without a separate merchant WhatsApp bill
onboarding.benefits.title: Built to recover revenue, not just send reminders.
onboarding.benefits.description: Every plan gives you the same core recovery experience. You choose the amount of monthly recovery capacity that fits your store.
onboarding.benefits.recover.title: Recover lost revenue
onboarding.benefits.recover.description: Reach shoppers after an abandoned checkout and guide them back to the exact purchase they left behind.
onboarding.benefits.conversation.title: Continue the conversation
onboarding.benefits.conversation.descrip: Customers can reply on WhatsApp and the AI can continue the recovery conversation instead of stopping at a static reminder.
onboarding.benefits.language.title: Designed for international commerce
onboarding.benefits.language.description: Merchant experiences are localised and shopper conversations can adapt to the customer language.
onboarding.benefits.pricing.title: Simple conversation pricing
onboarding.benefits.pricing.description: Pay for recovery conversations rather than individual WhatsApp messages or AI tokens.
onboarding.how.title: From abandoned checkout to active recovery.
onboarding.how.description: Moda Interact connects Shopify activity, WhatsApp messaging and AI into one automated recovery flow.
onboarding.how.step1.title: Checkout is abandoned
onboarding.how.step1.description: Moda detects an eligible abandoned checkout and prepares the recovery journey.
onboarding.how.step2.title: WhatsApp recovery starts
onboarding.how.step2.description: The shopper receives a relevant recovery message connected to the abandoned checkout.
onboarding.how.step3.title: The shopper can reply
onboarding.how.step3.description: If the customer responds, Moda continues the conversation using AI and the resolved customer language.
onboarding.how.step4.title: The sale can be recovered
onboarding.how.step4.description: The conversation guides the shopper back to their checkout while Moda records recovery activity and results.
onboarding.pricing.title: Start free, then choose the capacity your store needs.
onboarding.pricing.description: Subscriptions include monthly recovery conversations and unlock better value on additional conversation packs.
onboarding.pricing.free.description: Try the full recovery experience before committing to a subscription.
onboarding.pricing.starter.description: For smaller stores making WhatsApp recovery a regular part of their workflow.
onboarding.pricing.growth.description: For growing stores with more abandoned checkouts to recover each month.
onboarding.pricing.scale.description: For higher-volume merchants running recovery at scale.
onboarding.pricing.sameProduct.title: Same core product on every plan.
onboarding.pricing.sameProduct.descripti: AI-powered WhatsApp recovery, multilingual conversations, recovery analytics and no separate WhatsApp billing are part of the Moda experience.
onboarding.topups.title: Need more conversations? Subscribers get more for the same top-up.
onboarding.topups.description: Buy £5, £10 or £20 conversation packs when you need extra capacity. The higher your plan, the more recovery conversations each pack adds.
onboarding.topups.explainer: Your monthly included allowance is used first. Purchased conversation credits remain available until used and provide flexible extra capacity when recovery demand increases.
onboarding.topups.caption: Numbers show recovery conversations added by each pack.
onboarding.cta.title: Choose your plan and start recovering abandoned checkouts.
onboarding.cta.description: Start with 5 lifetime recovery conversations free, or choose a monthly plan for more capacity and better top-up value.
onboarding.cta.shopifyManaged: Plan selection and billing are securely managed by Shopify.
